quote_json: "If any requirement of this ECMA Standard is violated, the behavior is undefined."
requirement: Violation of any requirement of the old standard classifies the behavior as undefined.
notes: Later 5 omits this general indication. Old 4 defines undefined behavior without outcome requirements. The explicit old 2 diagnostic obligation for syntax and negative requirements remains a separate normative duty, and extension permission retains its diagnostic condition.

requirement: Beyond requirement violation, explicit undefined-behavior wording or omission of any explicit behavior definition indicates undefined behavior in the old standard.
notes: Read with old 2's immediately preceding violation indication and old 4's no-requirements definition. Later 5 indicates undefined behavior only with explicit words. This rule classifies specification text and does not cancel specific diagnostic duties.

quote_json: "There is no difference in emphasis among these three;"
requirement: Requirement violation, explicit undefined-behavior wording and omission of an explicit behavior definition denote the same undefined-behavior category without different emphasis.
notes: Separate equivalence predicate for the three preceding old indications. Later 5 retains only the explicit wording indication and drops this equivalence sentence. Old 4 still supplies the meaning of undefined behavior; no degree of runtime restriction is invented.

requirement: A conforming old implementation interprets characters in conformance with the Unicode Standard version 3.0 or later and ISO/IEC 10646-1.
notes: The old implementation-level floor and additional authority differ from later 5's Unicode requirement bound through the undated later reference. Old 3's Unicode citation and ISO/IEC 10646 all-parts reference are distinct documentary binding predicates in later 2. UTF-8 acceptance is unchanged and is not added as a changed predicate.
